---
title: "Outcomes: attending an over-demanded school, graduation and college outcomes"
output: html_document
params:
  data_dir: !r file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE", "~"), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data",
    "finalized_design_v1", "outcomes")
  out_dir: "output"
---

Tables of the outcomes section ("Effects of Attending Over-Demanded Schools") and of its appendix, and the
numbers their text quotes. The children who applied to ninth grade through SAE in 2016-2021 with the same chance
of an offer at an over-demanded school are compared, some offered and some not; each child's chance comes from one
million reruns of SAE's main stage. The effect of attending an over-demanded school is estimated by 2SLS with the
offer as the instrument, chance-group and application-year fixed effects, and heteroskedasticity-robust standard
errors. The notebook reads the data folder (`data_dir`) and writes `tables/` in the output folder (`out_dir`).

```{r setup, error = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(fixest)
stopifnot(packageVersion("fixest") >= "0.13.0")   # versions before 0.13.0 add a factor n/(n-1) to robust SEs

# folders: from `params` when given (rmarkdown::render, or a list named params defined before knitr::knit)
opt <- list(data_dir = file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE", "~"), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data",
                                 "finalized_design_v1", "outcomes"),
            out_dir = "output")
if (exists("params")) opt[names(params)] <- params
DATA_DIR <- opt$data_dir
TAB_DIR <- file.path(opt$out_dir, "tables")
dir.create(file.path(TAB_DIR, "results"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

setFixest_vcov(all = "hetero")            # robust SEs: OLS with the N/(N-K) factor, as Stata's robust
setFixest_estimation(fixef.rm = "none")   # keep chance groups that hold a single child

controls <- c("GPA8_Z", "ES_MUJER", "PRIORITARIO", "ALTO", "ORIGIN_OD")

college <- c(
  GRAD         = "Graduated from high school",
  GRAD_REGULAR = "\\quad Through regular secondary education",
  GRAD_ADULT   = "\\quad Through adult secondary education",
  APPLIED      = "Applied to a college program",
  ASSIGNED     = "Assigned a college seat",
  ANYWHERE     = "Enrolled anywhere",
  INSUA        = "\\quad First enrollment in SUA",
  OUTSIDE      = "\\quad First enrollment outside SUA"
)

ON_TIME_GRADUATION <- 4L       # graduation by the fourth school year after the application year
ON_TIME_COLLEGE <- 5L          # college outcomes by the admission process five years after it
LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR <- 2025L      # the year-end school records run through the 2025 school year
LAST_COLLEGE_PROCESS <- 2026L  # the college records run through the 2026 admission process

star <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.01, "$^{***}$", ifelse(p < 0.05, "$^{**}$", ifelse(p < 0.1, "$^{*}$", "")))
fmt <- function(x, d) sub("^-(0\\.0+)$", "\\1", sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x))   # -0.00 prints as 0.00
comma_int <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
row_tex <- function(label, cells) paste0("      ", label, " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
write_tex <- function(lines, file) writeLines(c("% Generated by outcomes.Rmd", lines), file.path(TAB_DIR, file))

# the coefficient on z (OLS) or on attendance (2SLS), its SE, p-value and N, one row per model; 2SLS p-values come
# from the normal distribution, as ivreg2's
effect <- function(fit, z = "OFFER") {
  models <- if (inherits(fit, "fixest_multi")) as.list(fit) else list(fit)
  bind_rows(map(models, function(m) {
    term <- if (isTRUE(m$is_iv)) "fit_D_OD" else z
    p <- if (isTRUE(m$is_iv)) 2 * pnorm(-abs(tstat(m)[[term]])) else pvalue(m)[[term]]
    tibble(est = coef(m)[[term]], se = se(m)[[term]], p = p, n = nobs(m))
  }))
}

# Tables III and IV and the appendix's estimate tables: caption, header, body and note
results_table <- function(top, caption, label, columns, header, body, note, size = "footnotesize") c(
  top,
  paste0("   \\caption{", caption, "}\\label{", label, "}"),
  paste0("   \\centerline{\\scalebox{0.85}{\\begin{tabular}{", columns, "}"),
  "      \\toprule", header, "      \\midrule", body, "      \\bottomrule",
  "   \\end{tabular}}}",
  paste0("   \\par\\smallskip{\\", size, " ", note, "}"),
  "\\end{table}")

# Table IV and Appendix Tables C.3 and C.4: each outcome's mean without an offer and its effect in pp, on time and ever
outcome_table <- function(top, caption, label, effect_header, est, n, note) {
  rows <- unlist(map(names(college), function(k) {
    ot <- est[est$var == paste0(k, "_OT"), ]
    ever <- est[est$var == paste0(k, "_EVER"), ]
    c(row_tex(college[[k]], c(fmt(100 * ot$mean, 2), paste0(fmt(100 * ot$est, 2), star(ot$p)),
                              fmt(100 * ever$mean, 2), paste0(fmt(100 * ever$est, 2), star(ever$p)))),
      row_tex("", c("", paste0("(", fmt(100 * ot$se, 2), ")"), "", paste0("(", fmt(100 * ever$se, 2), ")"))))
  }))
  header <- c("                   & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{On time} & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{Ever}\\\\",
              "      \\cmidrule(lr){2-3}\\cmidrule(lr){4-5}",
              effect_header,
              "                   & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4)\\\\")
  body <- c(rows, "      \\midrule", row_tex("$N$", comma_int(rep(n, 2))))
  results_table(top, caption, label, "lcccc", header, body, note)
}

# Appendix Tables C.1 and C.5: a plain tabular with its note below
tex_float <- function(caption, label, columns, body, note) c(
  "\\begin{table}[!htbp]", "\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}", "\\centering",
  paste0("\\caption{", caption, "}"), paste0("\\label{", label, "}"), "\\small",
  paste0("\\begin{tabular*}{\\textwidth}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}", columns, "@{}}"), "\\toprule", body,
  "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular*}", "\\par\\smallskip", "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
  paste("Notes:", note), "\\end{minipage}", "\\end{table}")

# the notes' sentence on the enrollment rows (Tables IV, C.3 and C.4)
ENROLLMENT_NOTE <- paste0(
  "Enrolled anywhere counts the students who enrolled in any higher-education institution; the two rows indented ",
  "under it divide these students by where they first enrolled, and a student who first enrolled through and ",
  "outside SUA in the same year counts in the SUA row.")
```

# Data

```{r data}
panel <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "outcomes_panel.rds"))                # one row per applicant child
applications <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "outcomes_applications.rds"))  # one row per application
entrants <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "outcomes_entrants.rds"))          # one row per 9th-grade entry under SAE
group <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "outcomes_group.rds"))                # the over-demanded schools
note_counts <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "outcomes_note_counts.rds"))    # Table IV's note
n_over_demanded <- nrow(group)

# Enrolled anywhere: the child's first enrollment, in SUA or outside it (each child is in at most one of the two)
panel <- mutate(panel, ANYWHERE_OT = INSUA_OT + OUTSIDE_OT, ANYWHERE_EVER = INSUA_EVER + OUTSIDE_EVER)
outcome_vars <- c(paste0(names(college), "_OT"), paste0(names(college), "_EVER"))
years <- paste0(min(panel$YEAR), "--", max(panel$YEAR))   # the application years
```

# Table III: balance and enrollment

Each row's variable is regressed on the offer, with the column's fixed effects.

```{r balance}
lottery <- panel %>%
  filter(LOTTERY_SAMPLE) %>%
  mutate(ANY_SCHOOL = as.integer(!is.na(ENTRY_RBD)))   # enrolled at any school in the entry year
lottery_1000 <- filter(lottery, LOTTERY_SAMPLE_THOUSANDTHS)

balance_rows <- tribble(
  ~var,          ~panel, ~label,                         ~label2,                             ~scale, ~digits,
  "N_CLASS",     "A",    "Choices ranked",               "",                                  1,      3,
  "N_OD",        "A",    "Over-demanded schools ranked", "",                                  1,      3,
  "FC_OD",       "A",    "Ranked an over-demanded",      "\\quad school first (\\%)",         100,    2,
  "GPA8_Z",      "B",    "8th-grade average (SD)",       "",                                  1,      3,
  "ES_MUJER",    "B",    "Female (\\%)",                 "",                                  100,    2,
  "PRIORITARIO", "B",    "Low-income (\\%)",             "",                                  100,    2,
  "ALTO",        "B",    "Top 20\\% of the school's",    "\\quad grade ranking (\\%)",        100,    2,
  "ORIGIN_OD",   "B",    "Enrolled at an over-demanded", "\\quad school in 8th grade (\\%)",  100,    2,
  "D_OD",        "C",    "Attends an over-demanded",     "\\quad school (\\%)",               100,    2,
  "ANY_SCHOOL",  "C",    "Enrolled at any school (\\%)", "",                                  100,    2
)
balance_vars <- balance_rows$var[balance_rows$panel != "C"]   # the eight rows of the joint test

balance_fits <- list(
  feols(.[balance_rows$var] ~ OFFER | YEAR, lottery),
  feols(.[balance_rows$var] ~ OFFER + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, lottery),
  feols(.[balance_rows$var] ~ OFFER + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS, lottery_1000)
)
balance_est <- map(balance_fits, effect)
balance_mean <- colMeans(lottery[lottery$OFFER == 0, balance_rows$var], na.rm = TRUE)

# joint F as in Abdulkadiroglu et al. (2017): Stata's mvreg, then test; on the children with all eight rows
joint_test <- function(d, rhs) {
  d <- drop_na(d, all_of(balance_vars))
  fit <- feols(as.formula(paste(".[balance_vars] ~ OFFER", rhs)), d)
  z <- resid(feols(as.formula(paste("OFFER ~ 1", rhs)), d))
  b <- coef(fit)[, "OFFER"]
  e <- resid(fit)
  df <- nobs(fit[[1]]) - fit[[1]]$nparams
  V <- crossprod(e) / df / sum(z^2)   # covariance of the eight coefficients
  f_stat <- drop(b %*% solve(V, b)) / length(b)
  tibble(F = f_stat, p = pf(f_stat, length(b), df, lower.tail = FALSE), n = nrow(d))
}
balance_joint <- bind_rows(
  joint_test(lottery, "| YEAR"),
  joint_test(lottery, "+ i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP"),
  joint_test(lottery_1000, "+ i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS")
)
balance_joint
```

```{r balance-tex}
balance_body <- map(seq_len(nrow(balance_rows)), function(i) {
  r <- balance_rows[i, ]
  cells <- map_chr(balance_est, function(e) paste0(fmt(r$scale * e$est[i], r$digits), star(e$p[i])))
  ses <- map_chr(balance_est, function(e) paste0("(", fmt(r$scale * e$se[i], r$digits), ")"))
  c(row_tex(r$label, c(fmt(r$scale * balance_mean[[r$var]], r$digits), cells)), row_tex(r$label2, c("", ses)))
})
panel_rows <- function(p, title) {
  c(paste0("      \\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel ", p, ". ", title, "}}\\\\"),
    unlist(balance_body[balance_rows$panel == p]), "      \\midrule")
}
with_gpa <- comma_int(c(sum(lottery$OFFER == 0 & !is.na(lottery$GPA8_Z)), balance_joint$n))

balance_note <- paste0(
  "Notes: The sample is the lottery sample of Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. Column (1) is the mean among students ",
  "without an offer. Columns (2) to (4) report the coefficient on the offer in a regression of the row's variable on ",
  "the offer, with heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses, and differ in what they hold fixed: ",
  "column (2) the application year only; columns (3) and (4) the chance group (the chance rounded to the nearest ",
  "hundredth or thousandth) and the application year, on the students whose group holds a student with an offer and ",
  "a student without one. The joint test is the $F$-test that the coefficients of the eight rows of Panels A and B ",
  "are jointly zero in a multivariate regression of those rows on the offer with the column's fixed effects. The ",
  "8th-grade average row and the joint test cover the students with that average: ", with_gpa[1], ", ", with_gpa[2],
  ", ", with_gpa[3], ", and ", with_gpa[4], " in columns (1) to (4). Rows marked \\% report a share in column (1) ",
  "and a difference in pp in columns (2) to (4). Choices ranked counts the choices the student ranked: a school, or ",
  "a classroom at a school with more than one 9th-grade classroom. Over-demanded schools ranked counts the distinct ",
  "over-demanded schools among them. The top-20\\% indicator is not recorded in the 2016 process and is set to 0 for ",
  "its applicants. Panel C refers to the annual enrollment census of the entry year. $^{***}$p$<$0.01, ",
  "$^{**}$p$<$0.05, $^{*}$p$<$0.1."
)

balance_tex <- results_table(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.0}",
  paste0("Lottery Balance and Enrollment, Application Years ", years), "tab: lottery balance", "lcccc",
  c("                   & No offer & No & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{Chance-group controls}\\\\",
    "      \\cmidrule(lr){4-5}",
    "                   & mean & controls & Hundredths & Thousandths\\\\",
    "                   & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4)\\\\"),
  c(panel_rows("A", "Ranked list"), panel_rows("B", "Characteristics"), panel_rows("C", "Enrollment in the entry year"),
    row_tex("$N$", comma_int(c(sum(lottery$OFFER == 0), nrow(lottery), nrow(lottery), nrow(lottery_1000)))),
    row_tex("Chance groups", c("", "", comma_int(n_distinct(lottery$CHANCE_GROUP)),
                               comma_int(n_distinct(lottery_1000$CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS)))),
    row_tex("$F$-test for joint significance", c("", fmt(balance_joint$F, 2))),
    row_tex("$p$-value", c("", fmt(balance_joint$p, 3)))),
  balance_note, size = "scriptsize")
write_tex(balance_tex, "results/lottery_balance.tex")
```

# Table IV: graduation and college outcomes

Each outcome is regressed on attendance at an over-demanded school by 2SLS, with the offer as the instrument.

```{r college}
estimation_sample <- drop_na(lottery, all_of(controls))   # the lottery sample with every characteristic

college_fs_fit <- feols(D_OD ~ OFFER + .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, estimation_sample)
college_fit <- feols(.[outcome_vars] ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER,
                     estimation_sample,
                     ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))   # 2SLS SEs without the N/(N-K) factor, as ivreg2's robust
college_fs <- effect(college_fs_fit)
college_est <- effect(college_fit) %>%
  mutate(var = outcome_vars, mean = colMeans(estimation_sample[estimation_sample$OFFER == 0, outcome_vars]))
college_est
```

```{r college-tex}
college_note <- paste0(
  "Notes: The sample is the ", comma_int(nrow(estimation_sample)), " students of the lottery sample with every ",
  "characteristic of Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. Columns (2) and (4) report 2SLS estimates of the effect of ",
  "attending an over-demanded school, with the offer as the instrument, chance-group and application-year fixed ",
  "effects, and the characteristics as controls (Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-estimation}); the first stage is ",
  fmt(100 * college_fs$est, 2), " pp (", fmt(100 * college_fs$se, 2), "). Columns (1) and (3) are means among the ",
  "students without an offer, in \\%; the effects are in pp. Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in ",
  "parentheses. On time and ever are defined in Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. A student who completes secondary ",
  "school in adult education counts as graduated; the two rows indented under graduation divide it by route, and a ",
  "student who also completes twelfth grade in regular secondary education counts in the regular row. DEMRE's ",
  "registration records list ", comma_int(note_counts$validation_completers), " students who completed secondary ",
  "school through validation exams or the recognition of studies abroad, two routes outside the year-end school ",
  "records; they count as not graduated. ", ENROLLMENT_NOTE, " $^{***}$p$<$0.01, $^{**}$p$<$0.05, $^{*}$p$<$0.1."
)

college_tex <- outcome_table(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}",
  "Graduation and College Outcomes", "tab: lottery college",
  c("                   & No offer & 2SLS & No offer & 2SLS\\\\", "                   & mean &  & mean & \\\\"),
  college_est, c(sum(estimation_sample$OFFER == 0), nrow(estimation_sample)), college_note)
write_tex(college_tex, "results/lottery_college.tex")
```

# Appendix Table C.1: the lottery sample's construction

The applications of the population, then the children.

```{r sample-construction}
funnel <- c(applications = nrow(applications), eighth_grade = sum(applications$ENROLLED_8TH_GRADE_APRIL),
            children = sum(applications$KEPT), lottery_sample = nrow(lottery),
            every_characteristic = nrow(estimation_sample))
funnel

steps <- c("Ninth-grade applications involving an over-demanded school",
           "Enrollment in eighth grade in the application year",
           "No preceding-year application; earliest remaining application per student",
           "Probability of an offer strictly between zero and one",
           "All characteristics used as regression controls observed")
funnel_note <- paste0(
  "Processes ", years, ". The first two rows count applications; the remaining rows count unique students. Of the ",
  comma_int(funnel[["children"]]), " students, ", comma_int(funnel[["children"]] - funnel[["lottery_sample"]]),
  " have offer probability zero or one and do not enter the propensity-score lottery sample. The final row defines ",
  "the sample for the main regressions with controls. Each admission-score regression further requires the ",
  "corresponding score.")

funnel_tex <- tex_float("Construction of the Ninth-Grade Lottery Sample", "tab: lottery sample construction",
                        "p{0.76\\textwidth}r",
                        c("Restriction & Remaining \\\\", "\\midrule",
                          paste0(steps, " & ", comma_int(funnel), " \\\\")),
                        funnel_note)
write_tex(funnel_tex, "lottery_sample_construction.tex")
```

# Appendix Table C.2: the children whose attendance depends on the offer

Column (1) is the 2SLS of $X(D - 1/2)$ on attendance, the offer the instrument, with the chance groups as fixed
effects and each child weighted by $1/(p_c(1 - p_c))$, $p_c$ the offer share of her chance group among the row's
children, so that every child whose attendance depends on the offer counts once. Columns (2) and (3) are means.

```{r characteristics}
complier_rows <- balance_rows[balance_rows$panel == "B", ]   # the five characteristics, as Table III's Panel B
col1 <- bind_rows(map(complier_rows$var, function(v) {
  d <- lottery %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    group_by(CHANCE_GROUP) %>%
    mutate(W = 1 / (mean(OFFER) * (1 - mean(OFFER)))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(X = as.numeric(.data[[v]]), Y = X * (D_OD - 0.5))
  fit <- feols(Y ~ 1 | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, d, weights = ~W, ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
  mutate(effect(fit), var = v, mean_all = mean(d$X))
}))

# column (3): the entries; low income is SAE's flag with a main-stage application, else the SEP roster of the entry year
entrants3 <- mutate(entrants, LOW_INCOME = if_else(MAIN_STAGE_9, PRIORITARIO, LOW_INCOME_SEP_ENTRY_YEAR))
entrant_cols <- c(GPA8_Z = "GPA8_Z", ES_MUJER = "FEMALE", PRIORITARIO = "LOW_INCOME", ALTO = "ALTO",
                  ORIGIN_OD = "ORIGIN_OD")
col3 <- map_dbl(entrant_cols, function(v) mean(entrants3[[v]], na.rm = TRUE))
mutate(col1, mean3 = col3)
```

```{r characteristics-tex}
complier_body <- unlist(map(seq_len(nrow(complier_rows)), function(i) {
  r <- complier_rows[i, ]
  c(row_tex(r$label, fmt(r$scale * c(col1$est[i], col1$mean_all[i], col3[[r$var]]), r$digits)),
    row_tex(r$label2, c(paste0("(", fmt(r$scale * col1$se[i], r$digits), ")"), "", "")))
}))
n_lottery <- col1$n[col1$var == "ES_MUJER"]   # column (1) is estimated from column (2)'s children

complier_note <- paste0(
  "Notes: Column (1) reports the mean of each characteristic among the compliers, estimated from the students of ",
  "column (2) by 2SLS with the offer as the instrument and chance-group fixed effects, each student weighted so that ",
  "every complier has equal weight, as in the semiparametric estimator of \\citet[p.~1402]{abdulkadiroglu2017}, ",
  "which follows \\citet{abadie2003semiparametric}; heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. ",
  "Columns (2) and (3) report means. Column (3) covers the 9th-grade entrants of the ", comma_int(n_over_demanded),
  " over-demanded schools (Section~\\ref{sec:allocation}) from the first class SAE assigned in the school's region ",
  "through ", max(entrants$YEAR) + 1L, ". Each characteristic is defined as in Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}, from ",
  "the records of the year before entry; for entrants without a main-stage application that year, sex and ",
  "low-income status come from the records of the entry year, and the top-20\\% indicator is missing. $N$ is each ",
  "column's sample size; each row covers the students with a value for that characteristic. The top-20\\% indicator ",
  "is not recorded in the 2016 process and is set to 0 for its applicants."
)

complier_tex <- results_table(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}\\small",
  "Characteristics of Lottery Compliers", "tab: lottery characteristics", "lccc",
  c("                   &  & All students & 9th-grade\\\\",
    "                   &  & in the lottery & entrants\\\\",
    "                   & Compliers & sample & under SAE\\\\",
    "                   & (1) & (2) & (3)\\\\"),
  c(complier_body, "      \\midrule", row_tex("$N$", comma_int(c(n_lottery, n_lottery, nrow(entrants))))),
  complier_note)
write_tex(complier_tex, "results/lottery_characteristics.tex")
```

# Appendix Table C.3: the offer's effect

Each outcome is regressed on the offer by OLS, with Table IV's sample, controls and fixed effects.

```{r offer-effect}
offer_fit <- feols(.[outcome_vars] ~ OFFER + .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, estimation_sample)
offer_est <- effect(offer_fit) %>%
  mutate(var = outcome_vars, mean = colMeans(estimation_sample[estimation_sample$OFFER == 0, outcome_vars]))

offer_note <- paste0(
  "Notes: Columns (2) and (4) report OLS estimates of the effect of receiving a main-stage offer at an over-demanded ",
  "school, with the same sample, chance-group and application-year fixed effects, and controls as ",
  "Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}. Columns (1) and (3) are means among students without an offer, in \\%; effects ",
  "are in pp. Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. On time and ever are defined in ",
  "Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. The rows are defined in the note to Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}. ",
  "$^{***}p<0.01$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{*}p<0.1$."
)

offer_tex <- outcome_table(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}",
  "Offer Effects on Graduation and College Outcomes", "tab: lottery college offer",
  c("                   & No offer & \\shortstack{Offer\\\\effect} & No offer & \\shortstack{Offer\\\\effect}\\\\",
    "                   & mean & & mean & \\\\"),
  offer_est, c(sum(estimation_sample$OFFER == 0), nrow(estimation_sample)), offer_note)
write_tex(c(offer_tex, ""), "results/lottery_college_offer.tex")   # the paper's file ends with an empty line
```

# Appendix Table C.4: first-choice admission lotteries

Table IV's 2SLS with a first-choice offer as the instrument and one fixed effect per first-choice admission lottery,
on the children of the first-choice sample with every characteristic, in or outside the lottery sample.

```{r first-choice}
first_choice <- panel %>%
  filter(FIRST_CHOICE_SAMPLE) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(controls))
first_choice_fs_fit <- feols(D_OD ~ FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER + .[controls] | FIRST_CHOICE_LOTTERY, first_choice)
first_choice_fit <- feols(.[outcome_vars] ~ .[controls] | FIRST_CHOICE_LOTTERY | D_OD ~ FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER,
                          first_choice, ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
first_choice_fs <- effect(first_choice_fs_fit, z = "FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER")
first_choice_est <- effect(first_choice_fit) %>%
  mutate(var = outcome_vars, mean = colMeans(first_choice[first_choice$FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER == 0, outcome_vars]))
first_choice_fs

first_choice_note <- paste0(
  "Notes: Estimates as in Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}, with a first-choice offer (a main-stage placement at the ",
  "classroom the student ranked first) as the instrument; each entry of a student's ranked list is one of a school's ",
  "ninth-grade classrooms, with its own seats. The fixed effects are one per first-choice lottery ",
  "\\citep[Section~4.5]{abdulkadiroglu2017}, defined in Appendix~\\ref{app:first-choice-iv}. The sample is the ",
  comma_int(nrow(first_choice)), " applicants of Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}, inside or outside its lottery ",
  "sample, who meet the conditions of Appendix~\\ref{app:first-choice-iv} and have all the characteristics used as ",
  "controls. The first stage is ", fmt(100 * first_choice_fs$est, 2), " pp (", fmt(100 * first_choice_fs$se, 2),
  "). Columns (1) and (3) are means among the students without a first-choice offer, in \\%; the effects are in ",
  "pp. Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. On time and ever are defined in ",
  "Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. The rows are defined in the note to Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}. ",
  "$^{***}$p$<$0.01, $^{**}$p$<$0.05, $^{*}$p$<$0.1."
)

first_choice_tex <- outcome_table(
  c("\\begin{table}[htbp]\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.0}",
    "\\captionsetup{skip=4pt}"),
  "Graduation and College Outcomes Using First-Choice Admission Lotteries", "tab: lottery horizon",
  c("                   & No offer & 2SLS & No offer & 2SLS\\\\", "                   & mean &  & mean & \\\\"),
  first_choice_est, c(sum(first_choice$FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER == 0), nrow(first_choice)), first_choice_note)
write_tex(first_choice_tex, "results/lottery_college_first_choice.tex")
```

# Appendix Table C.5: the outcome horizons by application year

```{r followup}
followup <- tibble(YEAR = sort(unique(panel$YEAR))) %>%
  mutate(graduation = YEAR + ON_TIME_GRADUATION, process = YEAR + ON_TIME_COLLEGE,
         more_years = LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR - graduation)

followup_note <- paste0(
  "Scheduled dates are the on-time horizons, which assume one grade of progression per year after ninth-grade entry. ",
  "The final column counts the years beyond the on-time horizon that ever outcomes add, through the latest records: ",
  LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR, " for graduation and ", LAST_COLLEGE_PROCESS, " for college outcomes.")

followup_tex <- tex_float("Scheduled Outcomes and Additional Follow-Up by Application Year", "tab: lottery followup",
                          "cccc",
                          c("Application & Scheduled & Scheduled college & Additional years \\\\",
                            "year & graduation & admission process & of follow-up \\\\", "\\midrule",
                            with(followup,
                                 paste0(YEAR, " & ", graduation, " & ", process, " & ", more_years, " \\\\"))),
                          followup_note)
write_tex(followup_tex, "lottery_followup.tex")
```

# The numbers the text quotes

Written as LaTeX macros: shares are plain numbers (the text adds the percent sign) and effects are absolute values
(the text gives their direction in words).

The text also quotes where the children whose attendance depends on the offer go without it: each share is minus the
2SLS effect of attendance on 1[the entry school's type] x (1 - attendance), specified as in Table IV (Abdulkadiroglu
et al. 2017, Table VII).

```{r destinations}
# "fee_paying" is the data's code for a private non-subsidized school
destinations_sample <- mutate(estimation_sample,
                              PUBLIC = (ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "publicly_funded_outside") * (1L - D_OD),
                              PRIVATE = (ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "fee_paying") * (1L - D_OD),
                              NONE = (ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "no_record") * (1L - D_OD))
destinations_fit <- feols(c(PUBLIC, PRIVATE, NONE) ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER,
                          destinations_sample, ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
destinations_est <- effect(destinations_fit) %>%
  mutate(type = c("publicly_funded_outside", "private_non_subsidized", "no_record"), share = -est)
destinations_est
```

```{r text-numbers}
# the placements footnote: the no-priority share and the schools where a random number decided such a seat
placements <- filter(applications, !is.na(RBD_ADMITIDO))
no_priority <- filter(placements, PRIORITY_CATEGORY == "regular")
by_number <- !no_priority$POOL_TYPE %in% c("S ordering", "T ordering", "G guaranteed return")
share_no_priority <- nrow(no_priority) / nrow(placements)

iv <- setNames(college_est$est, college_est$var)                        # Table IV's effects
rf <- setNames(offer_est$est, offer_est$var)                            # Appendix Table C.3's effects
# Table IV's effects in % of the means without an offer
of_mean <- setNames(100 * abs(college_est$est) / college_est$mean, college_est$var)
dest <- setNames(100 * destinations_est$share, destinations_est$type)   # the destinations without the offer, in %
pp <- function(x) fmt(abs(100 * x), 2)                                  # an effect in pp

macros <- c(
  ODSchools               = comma_int(n_over_demanded),
  LotterySample           = comma_int(nrow(lottery)),
  EstimationSample        = comma_int(nrow(estimation_sample)),
  NoPriorityShare         = fmt(100 * share_no_priority, 1),
  RandomNumberSchools     = comma_int(n_distinct(no_priority$RBD_ADMITIDO[by_number])),
  ChanceGroups            = comma_int(n_distinct(lottery$CHANCE_GROUP)),
  WithOffer               = comma_int(sum(lottery$OFFER == 1)),
  WithoutOffer            = comma_int(sum(lottery$OFFER == 0)),
  BalanceODRanked         = fmt(balance_est[[1]]$est[balance_rows$var == "N_OD"], 3),
  BalanceRankedFirst      = fmt(100 * balance_est[[1]]$est[balance_rows$var == "FC_OD"], 2),
  FirstStageTableIII      = fmt(100 * balance_est[[2]]$est[balance_rows$var == "D_OD"], 2),
  FirstStage              = fmt(100 * college_fs$est, 2),
  AttendanceNoOffer       = fmt(100 * balance_mean[["D_OD"]], 2),
  NoOfferPublic           = fmt(dest[["publicly_funded_outside"]], 1),
  NoOfferPrivate          = fmt(dest[["private_non_subsidized"]], 1),
  NoOfferNoRecord         = fmt(dest[["no_record"]], 1),
  OLSGradOnTime           = pp(rf[["GRAD_OT"]]),
  OLSAssignedOnTime       = pp(rf[["ASSIGNED_OT"]]),
  OLSEnrolledSUAOnTime    = pp(rf[["INSUA_OT"]]),
  GradOnTime              = pp(iv[["GRAD_OT"]]),
  AppliedOnTime           = pp(iv[["APPLIED_OT"]]),
  AssignedOnTime          = pp(iv[["ASSIGNED_OT"]]),
  EnrolledSUAOnTime       = pp(iv[["INSUA_OT"]]),
  GradOnTimeShare         = fmt(of_mean[["GRAD_OT"]], 1),
  AppliedOnTimeShare      = fmt(of_mean[["APPLIED_OT"]], 1),
  AssignedOnTimeShare     = fmt(of_mean[["ASSIGNED_OT"]], 1),
  EnrolledSUAOnTimeShare  = fmt(of_mean[["INSUA_OT"]], 1),
  GradRegularOnTime       = pp(iv[["GRAD_REGULAR_OT"]]),
  GradAdultOnTime         = pp(iv[["GRAD_ADULT_OT"]]),
  GradEver                = pp(iv[["GRAD_EVER"]]),
  GradEverShare           = fmt(of_mean[["GRAD_EVER"]], 1),
  AppliedEver             = pp(iv[["APPLIED_EVER"]]),
  AssignedEver            = pp(iv[["ASSIGNED_EVER"]]),
  EnrolledSUAEver         = pp(iv[["INSUA_EVER"]]),
  AssignedEverShare       = fmt(of_mean[["ASSIGNED_EVER"]], 1),
  EnrolledSUAEverShare    = fmt(of_mean[["INSUA_EVER"]], 1),
  FirstChoiceSample       = comma_int(nrow(first_choice)),
  FirstChoiceFirstStage   = fmt(100 * first_choice_fs$est, 2),
  FirstChoiceFirstStageSE = fmt(100 * first_choice_fs$se, 2)
)
write_tex(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\Outcomes%s}{%s}", names(macros), macros), "outcomes_text_macros.tex")
macros
```
